source.author: verg
source.text: Hic, pelagi tot tempestatibus actis, heu genitorem, omnis curae casusque levamen, amitto Anchisen: hic me, pater optume, fessum deseris, heu, tantis nequiquam erepte periclis!
source.text_original: Hic, pelagi tot tempestatibus actis, / heu genitorem, omnis curae casusque levamen, / amitto Anchisen: hic me, pater optume, fessum / deseris, heu, tantis nequiquam erepte periclis!
source.text_english: Here, after so many storms of the sea, alas, I lose my father Anchises, the solace of all my cares and misfortunes: here do you abandon me, best of fathers, weary as I am, alas, rescued in vain from such great dangers!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_original: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne / deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_english: Here the sister leaves the Aeolid, to remain through all time, alas, snatched in vain from her cruel stepmother.
